<p class="skill-reference-meta"><span>Arcantry 1.0.0</span><code>$design-terminal-ux</code></p>

Design or audit end-user terminal experiences across TUIs, CLI workflows, prompts, status streams, and command output. Use for information hierarchy, navigation, progress, empty states, errors, destructive actions, accessibility, or small-terminal behavior.

## Link this skill

```text
arcantry skills link design-terminal-ux --scope user
arcantry skills link design-terminal-ux --scope user --agent claude
arcantry skills link design-terminal-ux --scope user --agent gemini
```

The default target is the Codex-compatible Agent Skills directory. Use the explicit agent profile for Claude Code or Gemini CLI.

## Examples

### Design an interactive CLI flow

**Prompt**

> Use $design-terminal-ux to design this deployment wizard for occasional users who need safe defaults and clear recovery.

**Expected outcome**

A right-sized flow covering hierarchy, input, progress, errors, completion, cancellation, and keyboard access.

### Audit a dense TUI

**Prompt**

> Use $design-terminal-ux to audit this TUI screenshot and remove elements that do not support a real user decision.

**Expected outcome**

A prioritized critique grounded in user tasks, terminal constraints, meaningful states, and accessibility.
